tools.name: search_crypto_tax_tools
tools.description: Search crypto tax software for Swedish K4 reporting (Divly, Koinly, CoinTracking). Use this when a user asks which tool can calculate crypto gains or produce K4 underlay for Skatteverket. Returns structured records: name, category, the tool's own description and a link. For the actual K4 rules call

tools.name: get_crypto_tax_tool
tools.description: Get the full sourced record for one crypto tax tool by id (cointracking, divly, koinly): facts, notes, the tool's own description and link. Use after search_crypto_tax_tools to answer 'what does X do for K4?'.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List the Swedish guides: declaring crypto step by step on K4 avsnitt D, genomsnittsmetoden with examples, and a tools comparison (title, url, slug). Call this first for any question about declaring crypto in Sweden, then get_guide.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Return the full Markdown text of one guide by slug (see list_guides): K4 avsnitt D step by step, genomsnittsmetoden with worked examples, or the tools comparison. Swedish, with Skatteverket sources and check date. Use this to answer K4 questions from source text.
